title: Towards Holistic Evaluation of Large Audio-Language Models: A Comprehensive Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated through tasks such as speech-to-text translation, coreference resolution, sentence continuation, and question answering. It is also assessed via acoustic-triggered bias by presenting models with spoken sentences synthesized with voices of different genders and measuring their selection of stereotypical or anti-stereotypical continuations.

Assessed via acoustic-triggered bias by having models listen to context sentences synthesized with voices of different ages and evaluating whether they select stereotypical, anti-stereotypical, or unrelated text continuations.
